semantic_votes.rationale: This directive is confined to a generated JSON policy reference and prevents the embedded data payload from being treated as executable prompt instructions; the surrounding provenance sentence and fenced JSON make the boundary explicit.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the data-versus-instruction boundary and keep generated-reference parity checks against the authoritative Core contract.

semantic_votes.rationale: The absolute count is not an arbitrary operational shortcut: the authoritative Core contract enumerates exactly seven non-bypassable controls, and the prompt applies that closed set before carrying level evidence through dispatch.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain exact enumeration-to-count coupling; any contract count change must update the Core authority and prompt projection together.

semantic_votes.rationale: The numeric limit applies to a completed validation path under one bound identity, not to all validation activity; the same sentence permits another path only through a predeclared gap or evidence transition, matching Core.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the identity and gap-or-transition qualifiers adjacent, and fail closed when a completed path is repeated under the same identity.

semantic_votes.rationale: The prohibition is scoped to diff-export/no-edit. Returning supplied content or a host-native artifact avoids creating evidence files in a user-owned workspace while preserving the actual diff required by independent review.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the before-and-after workspace diff comparison; invalidate the utility result and block downstream review if the check changes or is unavailable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Formal readiness is an explicit release claim whose evidence obligation cannot be satisfied by merely declaring scope; Core lists formal evidence as a non-bypassable control and repeats the formal-scope rule.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the fail-closed formal-evidence gate and report blocked or partial whenever current formal evidence is missing.
